title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
quote: Users add eligible payment cards to ChatGPT Wallet once... The Wallet charges the card through a payment token, so card details are not shared with the dot or the merchant... Users review the items, the total, and the card before checkout and approve with a security check such as Face ID or a fingerprint... A limited number of U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers, ages 18 and up... some retailers block AI agents, and Amazon is the largest to do so.

title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
quote: A secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

title: docs(food): update ucp.dev for Food Checkout launch
quote: Removes the temporary "Food coming soon" announcement banner and updates See it in action > Food with the Food Checkout UI mockup, ucp-schema-validated checkout JSON snippet, updated description, and Get Started link. Adds dev.ucp.food.checkout under Capabilities and dev.ucp.food.fulfillment + dev.ucp.food.tip under Extensions.

title: Food Checkout — UCP Specification (draft)
quote: Unless the AP2 Mandates extension is supported, the checkout must be finalized manually by the buyer through a trusted UI. ... The Business remains Merchant of Record.

title: feat: Introduce Food Checkout Capability and Fulfillment & Tip Extensions
quote: Introduce Checkout & Fulfillment for Food Ordering... Enrich fulfillment representation based on learning from retail. Tighten normative clauses in the specification documentation. Enable common features like policies and actions on food checkout.

title: feat(identity)!: sign identity requests and attestations with key pairs or remote signers
quote: Lets the Web Bot Auth and TAP client provers, Attestation.sign and the World ID issuer sign with a key that never leaves a remote signer (a cloud KMS, an HSM, Turnkey)... Every remote signature is verified against publicKey before it is used... These take a key pair instead of a private key alone. Passing a bare private key throws a message that says how to migrate.

title: feat(identity): add Tempo ID extension
quote: Adds mppx/extensions/identity/tempo, which makes Tempo ID (id.tempo.xyz) an identity method... paymentCheck also refuses, before settlement, a payment that does not use the tempo method, whose source is not a Tempo Account the token grants to the app, or whose account Tempo ID screened as anything but clear.

title: feat(identity): add World ID verifier, prover and issuer
quote: Adds mppx/extensions/identity/world on top of the existing identity attestations: a human verified with World ID, as an Identity-Attestation of type world-id... Subjects are pairwise by default: an HMAC of World's subject and the audience, so servers can't link one human across them.
